model.title: To make improvements in the enactment of title 41, United States Code, into a positive law title and to improve the Code.

summary.text: The bill would make technical and conforming changes to the U.S. Code related to how Title 41, which governs public contracts, is formally structured as law. It aims to ensure consistency and clarity throughout the code following Title 41's enactment into positive law.
